_doc: Body atlas cells in pixels (x0, y0, x1, y1) of a 128x128 texture, v down. Tube parts are cylindrically unwrapped: u 0 = back center, 0.25 = character's right (-X), 0.5 = front, 0.75 = character's left (+X), 1 = back. Top of the part = top of cell. Feet: 'front' of the tube = top of the foot, top of cell = heel. Shared by make_clothes.py and build_character.py.
